buttonDescription1: The Carpathian valleys, in the village of Oriv, a cozy corner for unforgettable experiences is located in the middle of the mountains. Real Ukrainian mountains, homemade cheese making in the valley, waterfalls and centuries-old trees are waiting for you.
buttonDescription2: In Khmelnytskyi region there is a lost land - Bakota. A picturesque canyon with an ancient history captivates with its vastness and unusual atmosphere. Beekeeping, fresh honey from wild herbs, a touch of nature.
buttonDescription3: Not far from the center of Kyiv, an authentic Ukrainian village is located in the village of the same name, Pirogovo. Wooden mills, fragrant homemade bread, Ukrainian songs, and much more await you right now.
buttonDescription4: In the Odessa region there is a picturesque town of Vylkove. It is also called the Ukrainian Venice. Vylkove is a town on the water, all in canals. Located at the place where the Danube River and the Black Sea meet. People travel mainly by boats. An atypical Ukrainian village will not leave you without impressions.
active_vacation_text: Active recreation in atypical locations. Untouched nature and local flavor will give you unforgettable impressions.

resDetailTitle: Booking a house in the Carpathians
reservDetailText: Cozy wooden houses, hidden on the edge of the forest, will greet you with a magnificent view of the morning meadows. You can choose the number of rooms and the location that will be ideal for you. The territory on which the houses are based is suitable for both large companies that need to be close together in several houses, and for couples who want to be alone.
